title: Enchiladas
summary: If you are ever craving the classic cheesy mexican comfort food...
extendedSummary: If you are ever craving the classic cheesy mexican comfort food then this recipe is kind of perfect (at least for me). It is sooo fucking easy to make (at least the base enchiladas), but the flavour is super good imo. Unfortunately if you wanna go all out on the sides, you will need many ingredients </3 but it is extremely worth it

items: 2 cans of La Costena Enchiladas Red Sauce
1 pack of white corn tortillas (gf, should be 12 wraps total)
1 pack of shredded mixed cheeses (mozzarella, cheddar)
Cilantro (if you can be bothered, or have it on hand)

method: Finely dice the brown onion, and heat in a large frypan with olive oil until onions are soft and translucent.
Add minced beef, and bring up heat to high, and brown the beef.
Once fully browned, add spices, cook for a minute or two, then add the 1/2 cup of water.
Cook this until water is mostly evaporated, then add can of refried beans and mix thoroughly until a uniform mixture has been achieved.
Take off the heat, spread 1/2 of a can of the enchiladas red sauce at the bottom of a large oven dish (this is to avoid the tortillas from sticking to the dish)
Roll up your tortillas, placing a good glob of meat sauce inside each roll

Pack the tortillas closely, and if you have little space, layer the tortillas like a lasagne (the photo was made using 6 at the bottom, and another layer on top, with cheese and sauce spread throughout)
Spread sauce over the tortillas, and add a good layer of cheese on top
Chuck into the oven for 10 mins (covered), and 10 mins uncovered to get a nice cheese crust formed
For the guac, cube up and smash the avocados, add garlic mince, salt, pepper and lemon juice, and season to taste
For the pico de gallo, simply cube up the tomatos, and finely dice the red onion (super important the onion is finely diced), and drizzle some lemon juice throughout for the dressing
Serve up the enchilladas with lettuce, jalapeños, sour cream, guac, pico de gallo, and if you are feeling extra greedy some corn chips.
